title: Tillu, Golu and Pinky's Jungle Prank
description: A mischievous monkey, a gentle bear, and a clever squirrel team up for a day of funny jungle adventures.

scenes.description: wide shot of three friends planning their day under a tree
visual_prompts: (wide shot, cartoon brown monkey wearing red scarf, cartoon brown bear in blue vest, cartoon gray squirrel with green bow, sitting together under a large banyan tree:1.3), (lush green jungle clearing with flowers, vines, and grass:1.2), (soft morning sunlight filtering through leaves, warm cheerful storybook style:1.1)

scenes.subtitle: Morning Mischief
